# Appendix

## Appendix A: Data Sources

### Table A.1: Data sources used in the analysis.

| Source Name | Specific Dataset Name | Purpose | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plotly Sample Datasets GitHub Repository | geojson-counties-fips.json | Geographic data describing the borders of U.S. counties, used for mapping plots. | [Link](https://github.com/plotly/datasets/blob/master/geojson-counties-fips.json) |
| California Health and Human Services Geoportal | US County Reference Data | Provides the geographic center of each county, allowing for distance calculations between counties. | [Link](https://gis.data.chhs.ca.gov/) |
| US Census | County and County Equivalent Entities | List of FIPS county codes used to join data sources together. | [Link](https://www.census.gov/library/reference/code-lists/ansi.html#cou) |
| Centers for Disease Control | Daily County-Level $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ Concentrations 2001–2022 | Provides historical county-level $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ air pollution estimates. | [Link](https://data.cdc.gov/Environmental-Health-Toxicology/Daily-County-Level-PM2-5-Concentrations-2001-2022/53mz-4zqd/about_data) |
| Bureau of Economic Analysis | Personal Income by County | Historical county-level data on average personal income. | [Link](https://www.bea.gov/data/income-saving/personal-income-by-county) |
| US Census | County Business Patterns | County-level historical statistics on business count and employment levels. | [Link](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/cbp.html) |
| Bureau of Economic Analysis | GDP by County | Historical county-level data on GDP output. | [Link](https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gdp-by-county) |
| National Cancer Institute | County-level Population Files - Single-year Age Groups | Historical county population data. | [Link](https://seer.cancer.gov/popdata.thru.2023/download.html) |
| Data.gov | Residential Construction Permits by County | Historical record of residential building permits by county. | [Link](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/residential-construction-permits-by-county) |
| US Department of Agriculture | Unemployment and median household income for the United States, States, and counties, 2000–23 | Historical record of unemployment rates by county. | [Link](https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/county-level-data-sets/county-level-data-sets-download-data) |
| US Census | 2022 NAICS | Defines what each NAICS code means and when that definition was last updated. | [Link](https://www.census.gov/naics/?58967?yearbck=2022) |
| US Census | Download the National Counties Gazetteer File | Provides information on county land and water area. | [Link](https://www.census.gov/geographies/reference-files/time-series/geo/gazetteer-files.html) |
| US Bureau of Labor Statistics | Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages | Provides a count of businesses that meet the NAICS 518 definition for data centers. | [Link](https://www.bls.gov/cew/downloadable-data-files.htm) |

### Business Patterns Fields

For readability, @fig-erd-schema displays only the primary identifiers and aggregate measures in the `business_patterns` table. The underlying table also retains establishment-count fields by employment-size category: `est_lt_5`, `est5_9`, `est10_19`, `est20_49`, `est50_99`, `est100_249`, `est250_499`, `est500_999`, `est_gt_1000`, `est1000_1500`, `est1500_2500`, `est2500_5000`, and `est_gt_5000`.

## Appendix B: Supplementary Results

### Table B.1: Estimated five-year difference-in-differences effects of data center exposure on county outcomes, by cluster and treatment type.

| Outcome | Unit | C0: In-county | C0: Nearby | C1: In-county | C1: Nearby |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Trade & Transport Employment | % change per capita | -0.337<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(−0.579, −0.097)</span> | No effect² | No effect¹² | No effect¹ |
| Public Services Employment | % change per capita | No effect¹ | No effect² | No effect¹ | No effect¹² |
| Professional Employment | % change per capita | No effect¹ | No effect¹² | No effect¹² | No effect¹ |
| Primary Industry Employment | % change per capita | No effect² | No effect¹ | No effect² | -0.173<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(−0.308, −0.038)</span> |
| Information Employment | % change per capita | No effect¹² | No effect¹ | No effect¹² | No effect¹ |
| Industrial Employment | % change per capita | -0.759<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(−1.097, −0.421)</span> | No effect¹ | No effect² | No effect¹ |
| Nearby mean daily $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ | μg/m³ | -0.398<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(−0.662, −0.133)</span> | No effect² | No effect¹ | No effect² |
| In-county mean daily $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ | μg/m³ | -0.398<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(−0.681, −0.115)</span> | No effect² | No effect¹ | No effect² |
| Real GDP | % change in $1,000 2017 dollars per capita | No effect¹ | No effect¹² | No effect¹² | No effect¹ |
| Single-family permits | % change per 1,000 population | No effect¹² | 14.992<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(7.077, 22.907)</span> | No effect¹ | No effect¹² |
| Personal income | % change in $1,000 per capita | -3.793<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(−5.480, −2.096)</span> | No effect¹² | No effect¹² | No effect¹² |
| Unemployment rate | % | No effect¹ | -0.901<br><span style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d;">(−1.221, −0.581)</span> | No effect¹ | No effect¹² |

*Note.* C0 = Cluster 0; C1 = Cluster 1. “In-county” exposure is defined as crossing the threshold from two or fewer to three or more NAICS 518 establishments in the county. “Nearby” exposure is defined as crossing the threshold from 112 or fewer to 113 or more NAICS 518 establishments within a 50-mile radius. Parentheses contain 95% confidence intervals. “No effect” indicates no statistically interpretable effect because the estimate is not statistically significant (¹), the model violates the parallel trends assumption (²), or both.
